dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, what's your friend Ploy like?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌts jʊr ˈfrɛnd ˈplɔɪ ˈlaɪk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She's a person who always helps others. She's very kind.
dialogue.reading: ʃiːz ə ˈpɜːrsən huː ˈɔːlweɪz ˈhɛlps ˈʌðərz. ʃiːz ˈvɛri ˈkaɪnd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: She sounds great. What's her personality like?
dialogue.reading: ʃiː ˈsaʊndz ˈɡreɪt. ˈwʌts hɜːr ˌpɜːrsəˈnæləti ˈlaɪk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She's funny and outgoing. She's the girl who talks to everyone at parties.
dialogue.reading: ʃiːz ˈfʌni ənd ˌaʊtˈɡoʊɪŋ. ʃiːz ðə ˈɡɜːrl huː ˈtɔːks tu ˈɛvriwʌn ət ˈpɑːrtiz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not really. I'm shy with people who I don't know.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈriːli. aɪm ˈʃaɪ wɪð ˈpiːpəl huː aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈnoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Really? You aren't shy with me!
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? juː ˈɑːrnt ˈʃaɪ wɪð miː!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's because you're a person who makes everyone feel happy!
dialogue.reading: ðæts bɪˈkɔːz jʊr ə ˈpɜːrsən huː ˈmeɪks ˈɛvriwʌn ˈfiːl ˈhæpi!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thanks! I like people who are funny, so I want to meet Ploy.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! aɪ ˈlaɪk ˈpiːpəl huː ər ˈfʌni, soʊ aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈmiːt ˈplɔɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She's coming to our party on Saturday!
dialogue.reading: ʃiːz ˈkʌmɪŋ tu aʊr ˈpɑːrti ɑːn ˈsætərdeɪ!
